user.title: GEN24 Energy Control
user.description: Configure conservative Home Assistant orchestration for Fronius GEN24 battery policy.

data_description.solar_forecast_sensors: Like the Solar Forecast Card: one ordered daily list. Select at least 2 and at most 7 sensors: today, tomorrow, day 3, day 4, day 5, day 6, day 7. Each sensor must expose a daily kWh forecast as its state.
data_description.solar_forecast_remaining_today_sensor: Optional sensor for the forecast provider's direct remaining-today kWh estimate. When available, this is preferred so an overachieved daily forecast does not incorrectly produce remaining today = 0.
data_description.pv_production_today_sensor: Actual PV energy produced today in kWh. Used only as the fallback remaining today = forecast today - production today when no direct remaining-today forecast is available.
data_description.grid_export_sensor: Current grid export in W. Used only as a hysteresis signal so short cloud events do not cause immediate toggling.
data_description.battery_charge_power_sensor: Current battery charge power in W. Helps estimate how far the charge limit may be raised when export curtailment is likely.

error.forecast_entities_too_few: Select at least two forecast entities: today and tomorrow.
error.forecast_entities_too_many: Select at most seven forecast entities: today through day 7.
